title: Reasoning output cannot silently consume the pre-flight framing allowance
prompt: Frame an Atlas verification task using its saved correction and human-review requirement. Simulate empty or partial max_tokens responses, then a complete response, and repeat under explicit task/context ceilings.

assertions.requiredBehavior: Allow reasoning headroom while prompting for concise framing. Retry a token-limited response at most once with a larger effective allowance, using the same policy-filtered context and a bounded 60-second per-call timeout. Honor task/context ceilings and budget/cancellation checks. Track usage for both calls. Suppress streaming and never emit a truncated draft as complete framing.
assertions.failureBehavior: After exhaustion, an empty non-truncated reply, or a provider error, log the outcome and continue normal execution without an unbounded retry.

notes: Traceability specification, not an automatically graded live-model success score. Live acceptance must inspect a non-truncated provider response and the actual emitted framing message, not merely request-token settings or downstream task completion.
